text:
Jen Park: Proposal: add an 'elastic cushion' pool for Dedicated to absorb short tenant bursts without dipping into reserved quotas. Lightweight, pre-warmed, preemptible.
Priya Shah: High level guarantees? latency behavior if cushion used and when preempted?
Jen Park: Guarantees: up to cushion_size -> same p95 as reserved. p99 may degrade but we cap degradation in SLO. Preemption after configurable window (default 30s).
Sam Ortiz: How do we bill cushion usage? Customers expect predictability.
Jen Park: New 'cushion credits' balance. Credits replenish daily based on reserved commit. V1: credits expire after 7 days; billing via export CSV.
Luis Gomez: SRE: 30s preempt window seems tight. Need graceful drain + fallback routing to avoid mid-inference failures.
Jen Park: Spec includes KV cache checkpointing and immediate fallback to a compatible cheaper model on preempt. For sync requests we return a clear error code if fallback disabled.
Priya Shah: Launch plan? Recommend canary with 3 customers (web low-latency, batch partner, enterprise SLA).
Sam Ortiz: +1. Observability needs: per-tenant cushion burn, preempt events, extra latency, cushion-credit trend. I'll own dashboards.
Maia (devex): How will customers configure? UI + API?
Jen Park: Both. API: POST /v1/dedicated/pools/:pool_id/cushion {"size":<gpu_units>,"credits_per_day":<units>,"preempt_window_s":30}. UI slider with warnings about preempt risk.
Sam Ortiz: Server-side validation: default max cushion = 5% of reserved pool; enterprise opt-in for higher.
Luis Gomez: Autoscaler interaction: cushion exhaustion should trigger earlier scale-up. Otherwise we preempt and spike errors.
Jen Park: Autoscale rule: if cushion_burn_rate > threshold for N windows, immediately add +1 node and extend cooldown. Added to spec.
Priya Shah: Scope negotiation: billing model and credit expiry are product decisions. Suggest ship v1 with credit model + CSV export; consider pro-rated billing later.
Sam Ortiz: Rollback plan?
Jen Park: Per-customer UI toggle to disable cushion, routing fallback to reserved-only, and global kill-switch in console. Canary will test kill-switch.
Maia (devex): Docs: add clear error code for preempted requests (INFERENCE_PREEMPTED) and guidance on idempotency and retries.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/cushion-feature -> QA -> canary on p-canary cluster at 2135680000.
Jen Park: Timeline: spec PR this week, internal alpha in 2 weeks, canary in 6 weeks, GA in ~12 weeks if gates pass.
Luis Gomez: Add SLO gates: p99 latency impact < 250ms vs baseline for web canary; failed requests due to preemption <= 1%.
Priya Shah: Also require eval checklist: load profile, synthetic burst, KV cache hit-rate diff, billing export validation.
Sam Ortiz: I'll put action items in product board and own observability panels. Priya will recruit canary customers.
Priya Shah: I'll handle canary recruitment. Jen, open spec PR with API contract?
Jen Park: Will open PR and tracking ticket, linking CLI/snippet for canary. :thumbsup:
Maia (devex): I'll draft quickstart docs and examples for devs.
Jen Park: Thanks everyone. Reconvene after PR reviews.
